final: WITH s AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS st, AVG(modelconf) AS a FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS base FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT st, a FROM s, b WHERE a > base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS ma FROM q) SELECT q.st AS brokrepstat, q.a AS avg_modelconf, q.a - b.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.a / m.ma AS ratio_to_mean_qualifying FROM q, b, m WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND m.ma IS NOT NULL
